'''Prince Consort''' was the title worn by the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of a reigning [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[King/Legends|sovereign]] who was himself a [[Prince/Legends|prince]] in his own right. While he was married to [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Antilles]], [[Monarch of Alderaan|Queen]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] bore the title of Prince Consort.
